(C) current: global and US product pages (identical) and the PORTF p.16 data-sheet tables (Jan 2026): PG 8.0 MW(e), 31.0 %, '11,594 kJ/kWh (10,990 Btu/kWh)', 14,045 rpm, 14.4 : 1, 30.2 kg/s (66.6 lb/s), '534 °C (993° F)', NOx < 10 ppmvd; MD 8 MW version 8.4 MW, 35.3 %, 10,204 kJ/kWh, 13.9 : 1, 29.5 kg/s, 490 °C, NOx <= 10 ppmvd; MD 9 MW version 9.1 MW, 35.9 %, 10,003 kJ/kWh, 14.6 : 1, 30.4 kg/s, 504 °C, NOx <= 15 ppmvd; MD speed 5,750 – 11,500 – 12,075 rpm. (A) older: SGT-300 poster (2021; still the poster linked from the global, US and BR pages), CN page, BR page, PORTF p.16 summary block and PORTF p.24 imperial MD table: PG 7.9 MW, 30.8 %, 11,704 kJ/kWh (11,089 Btu/kWh poster / 11.094 BR), 14,045 rpm, 13.7:1, 30.2 kg/s, 543 °C (poster, CN; BR prints 534 °C), °F always 993; MD 8.4 MW (11,214 hp) / 9.1 MW (12,317 hp), 35.3 % / 36 % (36.0 %), 10,204 / 10,003 kJ/kWh, 5,750 / 11,500 / 12,075 rpm, 13.5:1 / 14.1:1, 29.5 / 30.4 kg/s, 490 / 504 °C. Mixed: PORTF p.24 PG metric row prints 31.0 % and 14.4 : 1 (edition C) with 11,704 kJ/kWh (edition A); PORTF p.24 PG imperial row prints 67.4 lb/s (= 30.57 kg/s) where every other document prints 30.2 kg/s / 66.6 lb/s. Rule applied: edition C (current manufacturer page) for every rating value. Note for the existing-package case: the Siemens HEA flyer (2026) still calls the installed fleet 'SGT-300-1S (7.9 MW) units', so installed single-shaft packages may carry the edition-A rating (7.9 MW, 13.7:1, 11,704 kJ/kWh, 30.2 kg/s); the flyer offers '~180 kW power uplift at base load (site-dependent)'.

extra.check: Two-way check: (1) second document - 8.0 MW, 31.0 %, 11,594 kJ/kWh, 14,045 rpm, 14.4 : 1, 30.2 kg/s, 534 °C identical in PAGE, PAGE_US and PORTF p.16 data sheet; flow 30.2 kg/s and 14,045 rpm also in POSTER, CN, BR and Centrax CX300-1S (30.2 kg/s, 66.6 lb/s); 534 °C also in BR and PORTF p.24; Centrax CX300-1S 536 °C at 7,886 kWe. (2) internal - 10,990 Btu/kWh x 1.05506 = 11,595 kJ/kWh (matches 11,594); 3600/11,594 = 31.05 % (31.0 % printed); 66.6 lb/s = 30.21 kg/s; 993 °F = 533.9 °C (matches 534, not the 543 °C of POSTER/CN: 543 °C = 1,009 °F); 130,000 lb = 58,967 kg exactly, but the printed '130,844 lb' = 59,350 kg (imperial figure inconsistent, metric kept); 39.0 ft = 11.89 m; 8.8 ft = 2.68 m; 13.1 ft = 3.99 m (consistent). Exhaust energy balance q = G*1.10*(T-15)/(P*(100/eta-1)) = 30.2*1.10*519/(8000*(100/31.05-1)) = 0.97 (edition A: 0.99; Centrax CX300-1S: 0.98; band 0.88-1.06).

records.notes: Current Siemens page values (edition C: global = US page = PORTF p.16 data sheet, Jan 2026). eff_pct as printed (3600/11,594 = 31.05 %). Older edition still live (2021 poster linked from the page, CN and BR pages): 7.9 MW, 30.8 %, 11,704 kJ/kWh, PR 13.7:1, 30.2 kg/s, 543 °C (poster/CN; BR 534 °C). Exhaust 534 °C taken: matches '993 °F' printed in every document (543 °C = 1,009 °F, poster/CN value is likely a digit swap - not resolved by a second Siemens source; Centrax CX300-1S 536 °C at 7,886 kWe). PORTF p.24 PG metric row pairs 31.0 % with 11,704 kJ/kWh (mixed editions) and imperial row prints 67.4 lb/s (30.57 kg/s) - not used. Weight '58.967 kg (130,844 lb)': 58,967 kg = 130,000 lb exactly, the printed 130,844 lb (= 59,350 kg) is inconsistent; metric value kept. out_rpm = turbine speed of the single-shaft engine = gearbox input. Package 11.9 x 2.7 x 4.0 m incl. AC generator, excl. inlet filter house and exhaust stack. comp_stages, turb_stages, starter, lube tank, VGV rows, bearings type, drive end come from the Centrax CX300-1S data sheet (third-party licensed packager), because no opened Siemens document states them; Siemens page gives 'single twin-bearing rotor'. Siemens HEA flyer (2026) calls installed units 'SGT-300-1S (7.9 MW)' - existing packages may carry the 7.9 MW / 13.7:1 rating. Prelim claims not reopenable: older datasheet 58,349 kg at 11.7 x 2.9 x 3.5 m (soar.hk, host blocked).

records.notes: Current Siemens page values (edition C: global = US page = PORTF p.16 and p.24 metric). eff_pct as printed (3600/10,204 = 35.28 %). Older edition (2021 poster, CN, BR, PORTF p.24 imperial): PR 13.5:1, all other values identical. PAGE prints the heat rate pair as '(7,212 Btu/kWh)'; 7,212 is Btu/hph (PORTF p.16 and POSTER print 'Btu/hph'; BR prints 9.666 Btu/kWh). BR swaps the lb/s figures of the two MD versions. out_rpm: nominal 11,500 rpm (100 % design speed of the drive shaft), range 5,750-12,075 rpm. MD package (6.9 x 2.9 x 3.5 m, 30,409 kg) common to both MD ratings, excl. driven equipment, inlet filter house and exhaust stack. comp_stages and VGV/bearing/drive-end details from Centrax CX300-2S data sheet (generator set on the twin-shaft core; third party) - no opened Siemens document states the compressor stage count.

records.turb_stages: 2 GG + 2 PT (2-stage gas generator turbine, 2-stage free power turbine)
records.out_rpm: 11500 rpm nominal (100 % design speed of the power-turbine drive shaft); range 5750-12075 rpm ('5,750 – 11,500 – 12,075 rpm')

extra.engine_designation: SGT-300-2S (twin-shaft; designation used by Centrax 'Siemens SGT-300-2S')
extra.fuel_gas_note: Required fuel-gas supply pressure not published. IFV flyer (applies to SGT-300): the Integrated Fuel Valve 'can translate to a lower required gas fuel supply pressure'; 'Up to 3 IFVs may be required depending on the number of gas streams i.e. whether the engine is non-DLE, DLE or EDLE.' Gas fuel module is common to SGT-100..SGT-400 (PAGE).
extra.inlet_exhaust_dp_note: Siemens rating basis only: 'All simple cycle and mechanical drive performance data in this document are gross values at ISO ambient conditions.' (PORTF); inlet/exhaust losses not stated. Centrax CX300 ratings: '* Inlet losses, exhaust losses & package auxiliary losses are excluded' (zero-loss basis), ISO 15 °C, sea level, 1013 mbar, 60 % RH, natural gas LHV 47,889 kJ/kg.
extra.engine_removal: Siemens PAGE: 'Large side doors on enclosure for equipment exchange'; 'Internal lifting equipment'; 'Package designed for gas turbine removal on either side'; 'Rapid core exchange option for minimized downtimes'; 'The core engine maintenance can be performed on-site or off-site.' PORTF p.16: 'Package is designed for rapid core engine exchange'. So the engine is withdrawn sideways (either side) through the enclosure side doors on the package's internal lifting equipment. Centrax CX300 packages: 'Integral engine and auxiliary maintenance beams'. Change-out time, lift weight and side clearance not published.
extra.compressor: 10 axial stages (Centrax: '10 Stage axial compressor'); 'Horizontally split compressor casing'; 'Horizontally and vertically split inlet casing'; 'The first stage rotor blades can be axially removed for quick and easy on-site exchange' (PAGE). Compressor (inlet) air mass flow not published.
extra.combustor: 'can annular combustion system with six reverse-flow tubular chambers, and a high energy igniter in each combustor'; 'six reverse-flow tubular combustion chambers positioned around a high-pressure casing' (PAGE); Centrax: '6 reverse flow combustion chambers (cans)'. DLE standard; up to 30 vol% H2 with DLE burners; Wobbe 50 down to 17.5 MJ/m3 (PAGE, stated for the single-shaft engine).
extra.package_contents: 'The packages incorporate gas turbine, gearbox (where applicable), drive unit and all factory-tested fluid modules, all of which are mounted on an underbase.'; fluid modules common to SGT-100..SGT-400: auto drains, gas fuel, lube oil, liquid fuel (optional) (PAGE).
extra.pkg_basis: MD package excl. driven equipment; 'Dimensions exclude inlet filter housing and exhaust stack. For power generation, the AC generator is included. For mechanical drive, the driven equipment is excluded.' (PAGE)
extra.fleet_experience: 'over 200 units have been sold, contributing to a combined fleet experience exceeding of over 10 million equivalent operating hours, which demontsrates a class-leading reliability rate of 99.5%' (PAGE; typos as printed)
extra.not_published: Not published in any document that could be opened (PAGE, PAGE_US, POSTER, PORTF, CN, BR, HEA, EVGV, IFV, CX1S, CX2S): core-engine weight and envelope (length, diameter), required fuel-gas supply pressure at the package inlet, lube-oil flow and heat rejection, number of bleed (blow-off) valves, engine accessory gearbox, number of bearings of the twin-shaft engine, inlet/exhaust pressure losses assumed in the Siemens rating, engine change-out time, Siemens-package starter type/power, Siemens-package lube-tank volume, inlet (compressor) air mass flow.
extra.rating_editions: Same two editions as described in record 'PG 8.0 MW', extra.rating_editions (edition C taken).
extra.package_editions: See record 'PG 8.0 MW', extra.package_editions (MD package 6.9 x 2.9 x 3.5 m, 30,409 kg identical in PAGE, PORTF p.16, BR).
extra.power_at: 'Power output | 8.4 MW | 9.1 MW' under 'Mechanical drive' (PAGE): power-turbine shaft output, ISO, gross ('gross values at ISO ambient conditions', PORTF)

starter.centrax_cx300_2s_generator_package: electro-hydraulic, 110 kW 3-phase AC motor ('Electro-hydraulic start system, 110kW 3 phase AC motor') - generator set on the same twin-shaft core, not the Siemens MD package

lube.siemens_package: Lube oil module (common SGT-100..SGT-400 fluid module, PAGE); volume/flow/heat rejection not published
lube.centrax_cx300_2s_generator_package: '5500ltr integral oil tank is incorporated within the turbine baseplate'; gearbox-driven main pump, AC auxiliary pump, DC emergency pump

variable_geometry.rows: variable guide vanes on stages 1 to 5 (Centrax CX300-2S, twin-shaft core; whether the inlet guide vane row is counted is not stated). NB Centrax gives 'stages 1 to 4' for the single-shaft core
variable_geometry.actuator: Siemens EVGV electric actuator retrofit applies to SGT-300 (EVGV flyer)
variable_geometry.quote: 10 Stage axial compressor with variable guide vanes on stages 1 to 5 (CX2S)

bleed_valves.quote: Pressure ratio 13.7:1, blow-off valves to prevent compressor surge (CX2S; the 13.7:1 there is the single-shaft figure repeated)

accessory_gearbox.note: Not published for the Siemens MD package. Centrax CX300-2S: 'Gearbox driven main lube oil pump' - the generator speed-reduction gearbox of that package

extra.drive_end: hot end (exhaust end) - 'Power take-off through exhaust end (hot end drive)' (CX2S, twin-shaft core)
extra.exhaust_exit: radial - 'Radial exhaust exit (Left/Right/Vertical)' (CX2S package on the twin-shaft core); Siemens MD package exhaust orientation not published
extra.turndown: 'The twin-shaft configuration offers excellent speed and load turndown characteristics to allow maximum flexibility of operation.' (PAGE)
extra.out_rpm_note: PAGE labels the row 'Turbine speed'; PORTF p.16 labels it 'Drive shaft speed' with '* Value shown indicates 100%-design speed of drive shaft'; POSTER '5,750 / 11,500 / 12,075 rpm'. Minimum 5,750 = 50 %, maximum 12,075 = 105 % of 11,500

alt_package_centrax_cx300_2s.basis: Centrax generator set on the twin-shaft SGT-300-2S core (title '8.5MW', spec header '8.6MWe', table 8606 kWe), ISO, inlet/exhaust/auxiliary losses excluded; two baseplates (turbine & gearbox / generator), each for single point lift; overall incl. inlet filter house (drawing)
alt_package_centrax_cx300_2s.note: Third-party generator package on the MD core - not a Siemens rating; '9748mm / 777in' inch value misprinted

extra.check: Two-way check: (1) second document - 9.1 MW, 10,003 kJ/kWh, 5,750 – 11,500 – 12,075 rpm, 30.4 kg/s, 504 °C identical in PAGE, PAGE_US, PORTF p.16 and p.24, POSTER, CN, BR; efficiency 35.9 % in PAGE, PORTF p.16 and p.24 metric; 36 % / 36.0 % in POSTER, CN, BR, PORTF p.24 imperial and PORTF p.16 summary ('35.3 – 36.0%'); PR 14.6 : 1 (edition C) vs 14.1:1 (edition A). (2) internal - 3600/10,003 = 35.99 % (closer to 36.0 % than to the 35.9 % printed on the current page; difference 0.09 pp, inside the 0.15 pp tolerance, printed value kept); 7,070 Btu/hph = 10,003 kJ/kWh; BR 9.476 Btu/kWh = 9,998 kJ/kWh; 67.0 lb/s = 30.39 kg/s; 939 °F = 503.9 °C (consistent). POSTER '9.1 MW (12,317 hp)': 12,317 hp = 9,185 kW (pair off by 0.9 %). Exhaust energy balance q = 30.4*1.10*489/(9100*(100/35.99-1)) = 1.01 (band 0.88-1.06).
